jobs.name: Hermes daily backup
jobs.prompt: You are maintaining a private backup repository for Hermes Agent state at /root/Hermes-Backup, pushing to origin https://github.com/LyrikNilpferd71/Hermes-Backup.git. Create a daily sanitized backup commit of durable Hermes state and push it. Use the existing /root/Hermes-Backup/backup-self.sh script if present; otherwise create/update it with the following policy: include ~/.hermes/config.yaml, ~/.hermes/memories/MEMORY.md, and ~/.hermes/skills/** while excluding secrets, runtime databases, logs, session data, and ~/.hermes/.env. Commit only if there are changes. After a successful push, report the commit hash and snapshot timestamp. Do not mention or echo any tokens or secrets. The schedule should be interpreted as Berlin local time (Europe/Berlin).
